newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia EON to announce results Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia EON to announce results Thurs.

text.p: Malaysian car distributor Edaran Otomobil Nasional Bhd (EON) will release its 1996 financial results after 0900 GMT on Thursday, a company statement said on Wednesday.
The company said it will also hold a news conference in conjunction with the release of the results.
EON distributes cars made by national car maker Proton Bhd and is a member of transporation-based group, DRB-Hicom.
